metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET lanyards and badges in bulk. Perfect for eco-conscious brands. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Choosing recycled PET for your custom lanyards and badges signals a genuine commitment to sustainability. Made from post-consumer plastic bottles, recycled PET retains the durability and vibrant printability of virgin polyester while diverting waste from landfills. These lanyards work well for trade shows, corporate ID systems, and events where your brand values need to be visible. The 3/4" Sublimated Recycled Lanyard, for example, allows full-color edge-to-edge printing that won't fade. It's a practical way to align your promotional gear with environmental goals.
heroAltText: Custom recycled PET lanyards and badges with full-color sublimated printing for eco-friendly branding
